source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate occsafe && python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import itertools

# === DATA (all from registry, v2 eval) ===
# Cell 1: Full OCC BN (Grad ON + BN)
cell1 = [0.654, 0.746, 0.776]
# Cell 2: Full OCC LN (Grad ON + LN)
cell2 = [0.798, 0.792, 0.740, 0.762]
# Cell 3: Detach BN (Grad OFF + BN)
cell3 = [0.794, 0.762, 0.736, 0.774]
# Cell 4: Detach LN (Grad OFF + LN)
cell4 = [0.802, 0.826, 0.778]
# Vanilla baseline
vanilla = [0.768, 0.748, 0.720]

print('='*60)
print('DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS')
print('='*60)
for name, data in [('Cell1 Full OCC BN', cell1), ('Cell2 Full OCC LN', cell2), 
                    ('Cell3 Detach BN', cell3), ('Cell4 Detach LN', cell4),
                    ('Vanilla', vanilla)]:
    arr = np.array(data)
    print(f'{name}: n={len(data)}, mean={arr.mean():.4f}, SD={arr.std(ddof=1):.4f}, SE={arr.std(ddof=1)/np.sqrt(len(data)):.4f}')

# === 2x2 FACTORIAL ANOVA ===
print()
print('='*60)
print('2x2 FACTORIAL ANOVA (Gradient Flow x Norm Type)')
print('='*60)

# Factor A: gradient_flow (ON=cell1,cell2 vs OFF=cell3,cell4)
# Factor B: norm_type (BN=cell1,cell3 vs LN=cell2,cell4)
# Using statsmodels for proper Type II/III SS

try:
    import pandas as pd
    import statsmodels.api as sm
    from statsmodels.formula.api import ols
    
    # Build dataframe
    rows = []
    for val in cell1:
        rows.append({'CAR': val, 'gradient': 'ON', 'norm': 'BN'})
    for val in cell2:
        rows.append({'CAR': val, 'gradient': 'ON', 'norm': 'LN'})
    for val in cell3:
        rows.append({'CAR': val, 'gradient': 'OFF', 'norm': 'BN'})
    for val in cell4:
        rows.append({'CAR': val, 'gradient': 'OFF', 'norm': 'LN'})
    
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    
    # Type II ANOVA
    model = ols('CAR ~ C(gradient) * C(norm)', data=df).fit()
    from statsmodels.stats.anova import anova_lm
    anova_table = anova_lm(model, typ=2)
    print(anova_table)
    
    # Extract values
    for idx in anova_table.index:
        if 'gradient' in idx and 'norm' not in idx:
            F_grad = anova_table.loc[idx, 'F']
            p_grad = anova_table.loc[idx, 'PR(>F)']
        elif 'norm' in idx and 'gradient' not in idx:
            F_norm = anova_table.loc[idx, 'F']
            p_norm = anova_table.loc[idx, 'PR(>F)']
        elif 'gradient' in idx and 'norm' in idx:
            F_inter = anova_table.loc[idx, 'F']
            p_inter = anova_table.loc[idx, 'PR(>F)']
    
    print(f'\\nGradient Flow main effect:  F={F_grad:.4f}, p={p_grad:.4f}')
    print(f'Norm Type main effect:      F={F_norm:.4f}, p={p_norm:.4f}')
    print(f'Interaction:                F={F_inter:.4f}, p={p_inter:.4f}')
    
    # Effect sizes (eta-squared)
    ss_total = anova_table['sum_sq'].sum()
    for idx in anova_table.index:
        if idx != 'Residual':
            eta_sq = anova_table.loc[idx, 'sum_sq'] / ss_total
            print(f'  eta^2({idx}) = {eta_sq:.4f}')
    
except ImportError as e:
    print(f'statsmodels not available: {e}')
    print('Falling back to manual computation...')

# === CELL MEANS vs VANILLA (Dunnett-like comparisons) ===
print()
print('='*60)
print('PAIRWISE: Each Cell vs Vanilla (Welch t-test + Bonferroni)')
print('='*60)

n_comparisons = 4
for name, data in [('Cell1 Full OCC BN', cell1), ('Cell2 Full OCC LN', cell2),
                    ('Cell3 Detach BN', cell3), ('Cell4 Detach LN', cell4)]:
    t, p = stats.ttest_ind(data, vanilla, equal_var=False)
    p_adj = min(p * n_comparisons, 1.0)
    # Cohen's d
    pooled_std = np.sqrt(((len(data)-1)*np.std(data, ddof=1)**2 + (len(vanilla)-1)*np.std(vanilla, ddof=1)**2) / (len(data)+len(vanilla)-2))
    d = (np.mean(data) - np.mean(vanilla)) / pooled_std if pooled_std > 0 else 0
    sig = '*' if p_adj < 0.05 else ('†' if p_adj < 0.1 else 'ns')
    print(f'{name} vs Vanilla: t={t:.3f}, p={p:.4f}, p_adj(Bonf)={p_adj:.4f} {sig}, Cohen d={d:.3f}')

# === ONE-WAY ANOVA across all 5 groups ===
print()
print('='*60)
print('ONE-WAY ANOVA (all 5 conditions)')
print('='*60)
F_ow, p_ow = stats.f_oneway(cell1, cell2, cell3, cell4, vanilla)
print(f'F={F_ow:.4f}, p={p_ow:.4f}')

# Omega-squared effect size
all_data = cell1 + cell2 + cell3 + cell4 + vanilla
grand_mean = np.mean(all_data)
N = len(all_data)
k = 5
groups = [cell1, cell2, cell3, cell4, vanilla]
ss_between = sum(len(g) * (np.mean(g) - grand_mean)**2 for g in groups)
ss_within = sum(sum((x - np.mean(g))**2 for x in g) for g in groups)
ms_within = ss_within / (N - k)
omega_sq = (ss_between - (k-1)*ms_within) / (ss_between + ss_within + ms_within)
print(f'omega^2 = {omega_sq:.4f}')

# === ALL PAIRWISE (Tukey-like with Bonferroni) ===
print()
print('='*60)
print('ALL PAIRWISE COMPARISONS (Bonferroni correction, 10 tests)')
print('='*60)
names = ['Cell1_BN_ON', 'Cell2_LN_ON', 'Cell3_BN_OFF', 'Cell4_LN_OFF', 'Vanilla']
groups = [cell1, cell2, cell3, cell4, vanilla]
n_pairs = 10
for i in range(5):
    for j in range(i+1, 5):
        t, p = stats.ttest_ind(groups[i], groups[j], equal_var=False)
        p_adj = min(p * n_pairs, 1.0)
        sig = '***' if p_adj < 0.001 else ('**' if p_adj < 0.01 else ('*' if p_adj < 0.05 else ('†' if p_adj < 0.1 else '')))
        pooled_std = np.sqrt(((len(groups[i])-1)*np.std(groups[i], ddof=1)**2 + (len(groups[j])-1)*np.std(groups[j], ddof=1)**2) / (len(groups[i])+len(groups[j])-2))
        d = (np.mean(groups[i]) - np.mean(groups[j])) / pooled_std if pooled_std > 0 else 0
        print(f'{names[i]} vs {names[j]}: diff={np.mean(groups[i])-np.mean(groups[j]):.4f}, t={t:.3f}, p={p:.4f}, p_adj={p_adj:.4f} {sig}, d={d:.3f}')
"
